news.headline: Retired tennis star Gaël Monfils named captain of France's Davis Cup team

news.headline: Islamist Militant Attack Forces Patients to Flee Ebola Clinic in Congo
news.summary: At least 44 people were killed in a brutal assault by a group loyal to the Islamic State, officials said. The area is a hot spot of the growing Ebola outbreak.
